transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this brief meeting because we have one mobile bariatric lift available for immediate assignment, and both the North and South inpatient units have patients whose transfer plans are being reviewed for use of the lift. Before I can finalize the assignment, hospital policy requires me to hold a brief equipment-readiness check with physical therapy, facilities, nursing education, and infection prevention. I'd like to go around and hear from each of you on readiness so we can make an informed decision today.
